evidence_candidates.source_locator: HBM comparison table and accompanying HBM4 note
evidence_candidates.excerpt: The IEEE EDS packaging discussion projects that HBM4 doubles the data-bus width and raises clock rate, increasing interconnect density and heat dissipation. It notes that the thermal increase may limit practical stack height and motivates finer-pitch bonding and system-level packaging work.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: HBM4's nominal bandwidth improvement introduces coupled heat and interconnect-density constraints, so architecture exploration should model attainable stack configuration and thermal limits rather than peak bandwidth alone.
